answers.text: For the last two years I have worked in our family's textile trading firm in Surat. I handle orders from about 25 regular retailers across Gujarat and Rajasthan. I started a WhatsApp catalogue with a simple order sheet, and repeat orders went up from 12 to 18 a month. I also follow up on payments. I want an MBA because I learned the trade from my father, but I don't have a method for planning inventory or pricing.
I can't share our turnover, margins or the names of our big buyers. That is the family's private information, so I can describe my own tasks only.
Our business is in a very dynamic and competitive sector. We continuously focus on customer satisfaction and process excellence, and I try to bring a modern outlook to the traditional business.
Overdue accounts came down from 9 to 5, but I did that alone as the business owner. Actually my father has retired and I have been running the firm entirely.
You are assuming that a family business does not give real responsibility. I disagree. I speak to retailers daily and I answer for my orders. It is not a lesser job than working in a company.
